Project numeric features onto principal components.

Fitted on the Train rows when a Data Split marks them (the means, deviations and components), then every row with all its features is projected. With Keep columns on, adds Float64 pc_0..pc_n beside the input columns (null on rows missing a feature); otherwise emits Float32 pc_0..pc_n alone for the rows with every feature, with the label as Int32 y and the split carried.

## Settings

| Group | Setting | Key | Type | Default | Allowed values | Read by | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Columns | Feature columns | `feature_cols` | Text | (empty) |   | The run | Comma-separated numeric features; empty auto-detects numeric columns. |
| Columns | Label column | `label_col` | Text | (empty) |   | The run | Optional label column passed through as y and excluded from automatic features. |
|   | n_components | `n_components` | Integer | `2` | `1-2147483647` | The run | Number of principal components. |
|   | center | `center` | On / off | `true` |   | The run | Subtract each feature mean before projection. |
|   | scale | `scale` | On / off | `false` |   | The run | Scale each feature to unit variance before projection. |
|   | keep_columns | `keep_columns` | On / off | `false` |   | The run | Keep the input columns and add pc_\* beside them. |
| Fitted preprocessing state | Mode | `operation_mode` | Choice | `fit_transform` | `fit_transform`, `transform_only` | The run | Fit on this input or reuse values fitted on training data. |
| Fitted preprocessing state | Save fitted state | `save_state` | On / off | `false` |   | The run | Persist fitted values to an engine-managed project artifact for validation, test, and inference. |
| Fitted preprocessing state | State artifact path | `state_path` | File | (empty) | `*.cyxstate.json` | The run | Existing training .cyxstate.json artifact required by Transform Only. |
| Fitted preprocessing state | Allow state overwrite | `state_overwrite` | On / off | `false` |   | The run | Allow replacing an existing state artifact. Advanced. |

**Read by** says whether a run uses the setting (**The run**) or only the editor, a dialog or a view (**The editor only**).
